title: OpenKeito
description: OpenKeito (Keito, 系統 = "power system" in Japanese): a free electromagnetic transient (EMT) simulator for power systems, for people and AI agents. Models are JSON documents; networks of pandapower and PowSyBl (CIM / CGMES) convert into models that start from their power flow; the solver is verified against closed-form solutions; it runs as a command, a Python package, an MCP server and a WebAssembly browser page. Dual-licensed under Apache-2.0 or MIT.
